interpretation: The seamen's-house indexes form a newly tested source family for the Pitea lead. The Pitea-filtered matrikel queries exposed no usable coverage, while the liggare endpoint was operational and returned Pitea- and Bygdea-linked records. After inspecting every principal Name field in the four complete Pitea-filtered name-result sets, none was Olaus/Olof Pehrsson/Persson. No exact birth-profile candidate was found. This is an index-, filter-, name-form- and visible-field-bounded result, not proof that the target never entered maritime service or never lived in Pitea.
limitations: The seamen's-house keyword search spans multiple fields; apparent two-term and date hits can come from ship, owner, voyage or note fields rather than the principal seaman's name or birth date.
The Pitea-filtered matrikel controls returned zero even for Anders, so no complete Pitea matrikel coverage can be inferred.
The liggare results establish that some Pitea- and Bygdea-linked records are visible, but they do not constitute a complete historical roster.
The exact D I a/1 and D I b/1 originals are not digitised or transcribed through MCP; no page was read.
The two Olof/Ol. Jung rows remain register-level near hits and are not merged, rejected as persons, or linked to P-0051.
Olaus Pehrsson remains an unproven father candidate for Barbro Christina Olofsdotter.
